 Follow Us On: News Movies Bollywood Inside Ramayana's action world: Ranbir Kapoor's stunt double shares BTS pics Inside Ramayana's action world: Ranbir Kapoor's stunt double shares BTS pics
 Stunt performer Luke Ioannou shared behind-the-scenes pictures from Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana. The images reveal elaborate action arrangements as he praises lead actor Ranbir Kapoor.
 Advertisement Ranbir Kapoor in a still from Ramayana. Photo: Youtube screengrab By: India Today Entertainment Desk New Delhi , Nov 8, 2026 11:52 IST Last Updated Nov 8, 2026 11:52 IST Published by shweta keshri Nov 8, 2026 11:28 IST A new behind-the-scenes glimpse from the sets of Ramayana has offered a look at the action sequences being filmed for Nitesh Tiwari's epic. Stunt performer Luke Ioannou recently shared pictures from the shoot, revealing that he doubled for Ranbir Kapoor in the film. He also spoke about his experience of being part of magnum opus.
 Sharing a series of pictures on Instagram, Luke expressed gratitude for the opportunity to work on a film based on one of India's most celebrated epics. He also had words of praise for Ranbir, whom he doubled for during the shoot.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story In his post, Luke wrote, "Feeling incredibly privileged to have been part of telling such an important story on Ramayana , stunt doubling for Ranbir Kapoor , truly one of the best actors I've had the pleasure of working with."
 He also thanked stunt professionals Ian Van Temperley and the G Stunt Alliance Group for bringing him on board. Acknowledging the cast and crew, Luke described the experience as an unforgettable journey and said he felt humbled to have been part of the film.
 BTS pictures offer a glimpse into Ramayana's action sequences
 The pictures shared by Luke provide a peek into the film's elaborate production and stunt arrangements. One photograph shows him alongside Ranbir, dressed in a traditional golden-brown outfit, accessorised with rudraksha beads and sporting a topknot. Another image offers a closer look at a costume featuring a chest piece and a maroon dhoti. 
 The post also includes glimpses of the film's action setups. In one photograph, a stunt performer can be seen standing on a large mechanical rig designed to resemble a mythical creature. Several wires are attached to the structure, with a blue-screen backdrop suggesting the use of visual effects in the sequence.
 Another picture shows a large camera rig set up for filming, offering a sense of the technical arrangements involved in bringing the film's action scenes to life.
 Luke has been associated with several major international productions. His credits include Wonder Woman, Wonder Woman 1984, No Time to Die and The Batman . He has also worked on the fantasy series House of the Dragon , known for its elaborate action and battle sequences.
 Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash , Ramayana features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. Sunny Deol will play Lord Hanuman, while Ravi Dubey has been cast as Lakshman.
 The ensemble cast also includes Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Kajal Aggarwal, Indira Krishnan and Kunal Kapoor.
 The makers have also confirmed the sequel, which is now scheduled to release in 2028, instead of the previously planned 2027 release. - Ends
